nodes.title: Acceptance: without Frobenius, restriction from overconvergent to convergent isocrystals is not full
nodes.statement: Let λ ∈ ℤ_p ∖ ℤ be as in liouville-exponent-sequence and h = Σ_{n≥1} p^n t^n ∈ K⟨t⟩†. On (G_m, P^1_k, P̂^1_O) let M be the free j†O-module on e_1, e_2 with ∇e_2 = λ e_2 ⊗ dt/t and ∇e_1 = h e_2 ⊗ dt/t, an extension 0 → K_λ → M → O → 0 of the unit object by the Kummer isocrystal K_λ. Then M is an overconvergent isocrystal on G_m, Hom_{Isoc†(G_m/K)}(O, M) = 0, and Hom_{Isoc(G_m/K)}(O, M) = K·(e_1 + f e_2) with f = −Σ_{n≥1} p^n t^n/(n + λ). Hence the restriction functor Isoc†(G_m/K) → Isoc(G_m/K), which is faithful, is not full, and the extension M splits in Isoc(G_m/K) but not in Isoc†(G_m/K). No Frobenius structure exists on M (Kedlaya's full faithfulness theorem with Frobenius would forbid this behaviour).
hypotheses: The exponent λ must be a p-adic integer, so that M is overconvergent, and not an integer, so that the homogeneous equation has no solution; its Liouville property makes the particular solution f convergent but not overconvergent.
proofSteps: Overconvergence of M: on the chart at 0, ∂^{[k]}e_2 = binom(λ, k) t^{−k} e_2 and ∂^{[k]}e_1 = a_k e_2 with a_k = (1/k) Σ_{n≥1} p^n binom(n + λ − 1, k − 1) t^{n−k}, whose sup norm on {η ≤ |t| ≤ 1} is ≤ k η^{−k} because binom(n + λ − 1, k − 1) ∈ ℤ_p; so ‖∂^{[k]}e‖ λ_0^k → 0 for η > λ_0 and taylor-series-convergence-criterion applies; the chart at ∞ (s = 1/t, where h(1/s) = Σ p^n s^{−n} is bounded by 1 on |s| ≥ 1/p) is the same, and overconvergence is local on P (overconvergence-is-a-property (d)). The connection is defined on the strict neighbourhood {1/p < |t| < p}.
Horizontal sections: s = c e_1 + g e_2 is horizontal iff c is constant and t g′ + λ g = −c h, i.e. (n + λ) g_n = −c h_n for all n ∈ ℤ; as λ ∉ ℤ this forces g = c f.

Over the tube {|t| = 1} sections are Laurent series with coefficients tending to 0, and f qualifies (liouville-exponent-sequence), so Hom_{Isoc}(O, M) = K(e_1 + f e_2); over strict neighbourhoods sections are overconvergent Laurent series and f does not qualify, so c = 0 and Hom_{Isoc†}(O, M) = 0. Faithfulness of restriction is coherent-j-dagger-modules (c).

A Frobenius structure on M would induce one on the sub-object K_λ, which needs (p − 1)λ ∈ ℤ (kummer-isocrystal), impossible since λ ∉ ℚ (liouville-exponent-sequence); the counterexample is constructed here, Abe's published counterexample (IMRN 2011) not being publicly accessible.
acceptance: The map Hom_{Isoc†}(O, M) = 0 → Hom_{Isoc}(O, M) = K is injective (faithfulness) but not surjective.

Replacing λ by an exponent with v_p(n + λ) = O(log n) (for instance λ = −1/2 with p odd, or any λ ∈ (ℚ ∩ ℤ_p) ∖ ℤ) makes f overconvergent and the two Hom-spaces agree; here limsup_n v_p(n + λ)/n = 1, so the failure is a Liouville phenomenon. No λ ∈ ℤ_p ∖ ℤ keeps |n + λ| bounded below, so the relevant condition is the growth of v_p(n + λ), not a lower bound.
In the convergent category M ≅ O ⊕ K_λ, while in the overconvergent category the extension class of M is non-zero.

coverage.note: Together with the 30 RD.3-prefixed nodes of the main packet (of which 22 are RD.3 targets and 8 sit at RD.5), every target of RD.3 is now a node whose prerequisite chains end in Mathlib, Tau Ceti, lower-tier roadmap nodes (AdicSpacesPartII, SchemeAndStackFoundations, CrystallineCohomology, InverseGaloisAndArithmeticFundamentalGroups, PerfectoidSpaces) or recorded gaps. This continuation plans the open items of the main coverage record from Berthelot's preprint 'Cohomologie rigide et cohomologie rigide à supports propres I' (IRMAR 96-03), which is public and contains the proofs the main pass recorded as unpublished: the étale tube isomorphism and the weak and strong fibration theorems (1.3.1–1.3.7, via the étale strict-neighbourhood theorem 1.3.5); the j† calculus, coherent j†-modules and their gluing (2.1); overconvergence as a property with the coordinate criterion (2.2); the independence of the frame and of the compactification with full proofs, the gluing construction without a global frame (independence of choices supplied here) and the Zariski stack property (2.3); convergent isocrystals and F-isocrystals and Dwork's construction from F-crystals with the comparison theorem (2.3–2.4); and the Monsky–Washnitzer description with Berthelot's theorem that a Frobenius structure forces overconvergence (2.5). Tsuzuki's finite étale pushforward is replaced by a construction from these results and Étesse's lifting of étale algebras; Abe's counterexample by an explicit Liouville-type extension on G_m; Étesse's direct-summand and étale-descent theorems and the Katz–Crew unit-root correspondence are planned, with Ogus's and Crew's unread inputs recorded as gaps. The ordinary convergent coefficient model and its crystalline Frobenius comparison (Guo–Reinecke §2.2, D'Addezio §2.2) are owned here by convergent-isocrystal, convergent-f-isocrystal, f-crystal-to-convergent-f-isocrystal, convergent-f-isocrystals-are-crystalline and underlying-bundle-of-convergent-isocrystal; the main node RD.3/restriction-to-convergent now targets them. Corrections and proofs for main-packet nodes are in `continuations`.
